name: qfd_vm_xfifo8_codex-c8f12-18af5339c
purpose: NPP12 eight FSW32 slices, 256-bit quarter-bank FIFO. Sixteen M5 leaves per region preserve all original FIFO pointer epochs without extra latency. Root upper bound 3544 sinks; reset fanout predicted 193 instead of measured 386 on the 32-slice predecessor. Requires measured physical gate and full signoff before die adoption.
